-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.api.wsRecvI_excl (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (rs rs' : List mvcc.api.WResp) : mvcc.api.wsRecvI
    ι rs ∗ mvcc.api.wsRecvI ι rs' ⊢ False

def mvcc.api.wsRecvI (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l dec,
      ghostVar ι.rcv (Qp.half 1) rs ∗
        monoNatAuthOwn ι.rx 1 0 ∗
          mvcc.api.logTok ι l dec ∗
            monoNatLbOwn ι.ns (mvcc.api.sent.nsCount l) ∗
              ⌜rs <+: mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l⌝ ∗
                ∃ ms, ghostVar ι.crecv (Qp.half 1) ms ∗ ⌜List.map mvcc.RespM.toW ms = rs⌝)

theorem mvcc.api.lbsOk_of_sendLbs (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l
    : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (h : ∀ (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv), e ∈ l → mvcc.api.sendLbs σ.notifiedLog
    σ.crev e) : mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk σ (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).F

theorem mvcc.api.wsStateI_excl (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (S S' : mvcc.api.StreamState) :
    mvcc.api.wsStateI ι S ∗ mvcc.api.wsStateI ι S' ⊢ False

theorem mvcc.api.wsRecvI_timeless (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp) : Timeless
    (mvcc.api.wsRecvI ι rs)

theorem mvcc.api.evTok_timeless (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : Timeless
    (mvcc.api.evTok a e)

theorem mvcc.api.crevAtLeast_timeless (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (c : Int) : Timeless
    (mvcc.api.crevAtLeast a c)

theorem mvcc.api.evTok_lbs (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (hr :
    mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.nlAuth a 1 σ.notifiedLog ∗
    mvcc.api.crevAuth a (Qp.half 1) σ.crev ∗ mvcc.api.evTok a e ⊢ ⌜mvcc.api.sendLbs σ.notifiedLog
    σ.crev e⌝

theorem mvcc.api.logTok_timeless (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName →
    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : Timeless (mvcc.api.logTok ι l dec)

def mvcc.api.wsSentLbI (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜n = 0⌝ ∨ ∃ l, monoListLbOwn ι.ev l ∗ ⌜n ≤ (mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l).length⌝)

theorem mvcc.api.wsSentLbI_persistent (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (n : Nat) : Persistent
    (mvcc.api.wsSentLbI ι n)

theorem mvcc.api.sepL_get {A : Type} (Φ : A → IProp GF) [hΦ : ∀ (x : A), Persistent (Φ x)] (l : List
    A) : ([∗list] x ∈ l, Φ x) ⊢ □ ∀ x, ⌜x ∈ l⌝ -∗ Φ x

def mvcc.api.sendLbs (N : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) : mvcc.api.sent.SEv → Prop :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead => L <+: N ∧ c0 ≤ c
  | x => True

theorem mvcc.api.wsRecv_okI [ReceiptGS GF] (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp) (S :
    mvcc.api.StreamState) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : mvcc.api.wsRecvI ι rs ∗ mvcc.api.wsStateI ι S ∗
    mvcc.api.mvccStateI ι.st σ ⊢ ⌜mvcc.api.wsRecvOk σ S rs⌝

def mvcc.api.logTok (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM
    → Bool)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListLbOwn ι.ev l ∗
      ⌜mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l⌝ ∗
        ([∗list] fg ∈ mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf l, mvcc.api.savedFilters fg (dec fg)) ∗ [∗list] e ∈ l, mvcc.api.evTok ι.st e)

theorem mvcc.api.savedFilters_timeless (γ : GName) (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : Timeless
    (mvcc.api.savedFilters γ fs)

def mvcc.api.wsStateI (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l dec,
      ghostVar ι.cl (Qp.half 1) l ∗
        monoNatAuthOwn ι.ns 1 (mvcc.api.sent.nsCount l) ∗ mvcc.api.logTok ι l dec ∗ ⌜(mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S = S⌝)

def mvcc.api.evTok (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) : mvcc.api.sent.SEv → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead => iprop(mvcc.api.nlLb a L ∗ mvcc.api.crevAtLeast a c0)
  | x => iprop(True)

def mvcc.RespM.toW (x : mvcc.RespM) : mvcc.api.WResp :=
  { id := x.id, evs := x.evs, rev := x.rev, compactRev := x.compactRev }

theorem mvcc.api.savedFilters_agreeL (A B : List GName) (d d' : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) :
    (([∗list] fg ∈ A, mvcc.api.savedFilters fg (d fg)) ∗ [∗list] fg ∈ B, mvcc.api.savedFilters fg
    (d' fg)) ⊢ ⌜∀ (fg : GName), fg ∈ A → fg ∈ B → d fg = d' fg⌝

theorem mvcc.api.evTok_persistent (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : Persistent
    (mvcc.api.evTok a e)

theorem mvcc.api.mvccStateI_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState)
    : Timeless (mvcc.api.mvccStateI a σ)

def mvcc.api.mvccStateI [ReceiptGS GF] (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(mvcc.api.absPart a (Qp.half 1) σ.log σ.crev ∗
      mvcc.api.pndPart a (Qp.half 1) σ.pending ∗
        mvcc.api.crevAuth a (Qp.half 1) σ.crev ∗
          mvcc.api.nlAuth a 1 σ.notifiedLog ∗ ⌜mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ⌝ ∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh σ.log))

theorem mvcc.api.evToks_lbs (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (hr :
    mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : (mvcc.api.nlAuth a 1 σ.notifiedLog ∗
    mvcc.api.crevAuth a (Qp.half 1) σ.crev ∗ [∗list] e ∈ l, mvcc.api.evTok a e) ⊢ ⌜∀ (e :
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv), e ∈ l → mvcc.api.sendLbs σ.notifiedLog σ.crev e⌝

theorem mvcc.api.mvccStateI_excl [ReceiptGS GF] (a : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (σ σ' : mvcc.api.MvccState)
    : mvcc.api.mvccStateI a σ ∗ mvcc.api.mvccStateI a σ' ⊢ False

theorem mvcc.api.reach_crev (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ → -1 ≤ σ.crev

theorem mvcc.api.logTok_persistent (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName →
    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : Persistent (mvcc.api.logTok ι l dec)

structure mvcc.api.WsAbs : Type where
  st : mvcc.api.AbsNames
  ev : GName
  ns : GName
  rcv : GName
  rx : GName
  ch : GoChan
  chn : ChanNames
  crecv : GName
  cl : GName

theorem mvcc.api.wsSentLbI_zero (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) : ⊢ mvcc.api.wsSentLbI ι 0

theorem mvcc.api.wsStateI_timeless (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) : Timeless
    (mvcc.api.wsStateI ι S)
